name: vault-graph
preconditions: Obsidian Desktop is running with the vault open
vault has concepts/, hubs/, projects/ folders
constraints: never fabricate links — only nodes from CLI or grep
obsidian search is broken in installer 1.12.x; use filesystem grep for keyword seeds
cap expansion to 2 hops total; cap output to top 30 by default
skill is read-only — gap fixes are recommendations, never edits
